text: Integrates via REST APIs, a JS snippet, and iOS/Android SDKs
quote: Sift easily integrates into your existing systems using modern REST APIs, Javascript snippet, and SDKs for iOS and Android.

text: Send user lifecycle event data (signups, orders, posts) to Sift via the Events REST API
quote: What actions your users are taking, usually key user lifecycle events (e.g., creating an account, placing an order, posting content to other users, etc.). You will send this data from your application to Sift via our REST API.

text: Send business decision actions (approve, block, cancel) back to Sift via the Decisions API
quote: What actions your business is taking in response to users (e.g., approve an order, block and event due to fraud, cancel order due to chargeback, etc). You will also send this data from your application to Sift via our Decisions API.

text: Backfill months of historical data to jump-start and improve model accuracy
quote: Because Sift gets smarter the more data it has about your business, you can jump start your integration by backfilling a few months worth of historical data.

text: Produces a 0-100 risk score where higher means riskier
quote: Sift represents this risk with a score between 0 and 100, where risky events have higher scores.

text: Workflows let you build custom rule-based real-time decisioning on key events
quote: Workflows enable you to make risk-based decisions in real time during key events. Follow this guide to create your own custom Workflow.

text: Configure custom Decisions (e.g. Ban Account, Cancel Order) tied to real backend business actions
quote: Learn to set up custom Decisions, like Ban Account or Cancel Order, that are connected to real business actions in your backend.

text: Add abuse-specific risk scores to target multiple distinct fraud types at once
quote: Want to fight multiple types of fraud at once? Learn how to add an abuse-specific risk score so that you can easily do so.

text: Define custom events and fields to capture user actions not covered by built-in events
quote: Custom events and fields describe user actions not captured by the supported events in our Events API.

text: Provides a session_id field to track anonymous users across the JS snippet and Events API
quote: When users are anonymous for parts or all of their experience on your site, we provide a special `session_id` field in the JS Snippet and Events API.

text: Offers Review Queues alongside Workflows for managing flagged cases
quote: Sift offers Workflows, a powerful rules automation platform, and Review Queues.

text: Blocks unauthorized access attempts (account takeover) in real time
quote: Block unauthorized access in real time.

text: Stops fraudulent account signups at creation time
quote: Stop fraudulent signups at the door.

text: Improves order approval rates while reducing declines on legitimate orders
quote: Approve more and decline fewer legit orders.
